eval.description: Gray Swan Shade adaptive red-teaming for indirect prompt injection in coding-agent environments. An attacker agent refines attacks over many attempts (often 200 per scenario; Anthropic cards use about 40 scenarios) to divert the target into harmful tool actions. Headline metric is attack success rate (lower is better). Not SHADE-Arena. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often hidden attacker instructions in coding tasks trick AI agents into harmful tool actions.

links.title: Claude Opus 5 system card (Shade coding results)

versions.changes: Attacker training and scenario sets change across cards; Anthropic warns results are not always comparable when a new attacker is trained.

scores.description: The adaptive Shade attacker diverted the coding agent into the harmful goal on this attempt.

metrics.description: Fraction of attacker attempts that succeed. Cards often also report scenario-level ASR (any success in N attempts).
